skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK DMG to each enemy in a row with 2 combo strikes, with a 100% chance to inflict [Shatter] on the main target for 2 turns (reduces DMG RED. rate by 30%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK DMG to each enemy in a row with 2 combo strikes, with a 100% chance to inflict [Shatter] on the main target and a 50% chance on enemies in the same row as the main target for 2 turns (reduces DMG RED. rate by 30%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an ally attacks an enemy in the [Shatter] state, Iairon enters the [Berserk] state for 99 turns (increases DMG dealt by 30%).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an allied character attacks an enemy in the [Shatter] state, Iairon enters the [Berserk] state for 99 turns (increases DMG dealt by 40%).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an allied character attacks an enemy in the [Shatter] state, Iairon enters the [Berserk] state for 99 turns (increases DMG dealt by 45%).
